name: Ricold
source:
The head of the academic city, Ryumeitō.

A mysterious individual [spoiler]housing two souls—Rico and Lud—within a single body.[/spoiler]

Calm, friendly, and approachable, he lends his support to the heroine and her companions.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
